All trials remain in headline results and per-run intervals are separate. The bounded execution comparison and its report are complete, without model/configuration expansion to pursue the target. The activity baseline remains stronger on the shared 8192-query validation cohort. Historical snapshot assumptions remain unresolved. Notebook 07 directly observed four 228-240 ms full Python collections inside slow online passes across modes and sizes. Instrumented controls do not supply corrected speedup estimates: forced collection relocated 88.656 seconds outside timers, and the short acyclic control does not establish elimination of long-run pauses.
